I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet. It needs sign-off first because it carries the Quarrendon 2027 per-seat rate.

**Why:** A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so he isn't one of them, and that applies even to a draft. You own the account, so you can see the figure, but that doesn't let you pass it on to Hollis without June's or Anselm's OK.

**What I did:**
- **Approval request:** I logged a request for June Osei-Lark to approve this exact draft. It would go to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" and state the proposed per-seat rate. It's still pending.
- **Reply to you:** I explained this in a thread on your message in our DM.
- **What I didn't send:** I didn't put the rate in the request or in any other conversation.

**Next step:** Please ask June (or Anselm) to approve it. Once one of them does, I'll save the draft in your mailbox for you to send. If Hollis only needs details that aren't money terms for the territory review, like seat counts or renewal dates, I can draft that version now.
